These photographs materially strengthen the ecological record because the specimen is shown upright and attached before collection.
DIAGNOSTIC NOTE: The combination of a pale cream-buff pileus with slightly darker center, pale buff to pinkish-buff lamellae, long slender fibrillose stipe, and solitary growth from dense moss provides a substantially improved macromorphological and ecological dataset for JN2-F3.
